messages:
maria: Heads up — p99 spikes on production inference since 03:10 UTC, looks correlated with long prompt loads + tool-calls. p95 ~160ms, p99 ~1.1s. Profile attached? :eyes:
ashwin: Do we have flamegraphs from the runtime sampler? I can attach a sampled profile from the 03:10 window.
maria: here's a quick sampled profile snippet from the window:
```text
Top stacks (sampled 2000 samples):
- runtime::dispatch_kernel (28%)
- kv_cache::get_or_init (14%)
- batching::microbatch_enqueue (10%)
- tokenizer::long_context_handle (8%)
- tool_invoke::call_loop (6%)
```
ashwin: Interesting: kernel dispatch dominates but kv_cache is second. Could be cache-miss amplification due to long prompt concatenation.
sam: Found a repro trace: tool-calling loop that appends assistant+tool responses to prompt without trimming system hints. For ~1/3000 requests the length grows to ~120k tokens, causing repeated K/V lookups and kernel path switching.
olivia: That explains the kernel-choice flapping: short contexts use fast fused-attn, long contexts fallback to chunked attention (slower). Microbatch heuristics then batch mixed lengths -> serialization.
perf-bot: experiment 1893 started: microbatch_size=8 -> 16; kv_prefix_truncate=true
ashwin: Ran local microbench (3000 iters):
- baseline microbatch=8: p95=160ms p99=980ms throughput=11.8k tok/s
- with kv_prefix_truncate: p95=150ms p99=420ms throughput=9.6k tok/s
- with length_bucket=adaptive (force homogeneous batches): p95=140ms p99=320ms throughput=9.0k tok/s
sam: Key root cause is two-fold: (1) rare long-prompt outliers create KV cache misses and force kernel fallback, (2) microbatching mixed lengths amplifies tail latency by serializing short requests behind long ones.
maria: Quick mitigation options: (A) prefix-truncate long prompts before serving (B) enforce length-bucketed microbatching (C) add quick-circuit for tool-call loops to cap appended history.
jeremy: Also found small bug: kv cache key formatting had an off-by-one when context marker appended -> caused duplicate cache keys and prevented reuse. Patch pushed to staging: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4521 :shipit: 
olivia: Can we get a safe rollout plan? I'd prefer (1) config toggle for kv_prefix_truncate, (2) opt-in length_bucket rollout, (3) patch for key formatting behind feature flag.
maria: Agreed. Action items:
- ashwin: publish microbench numbers + flamegraphs (ETA 2h)
- sam: add repro harness that simulates tool-call loops and long prompt growth (ETA EOD)
- jeremy: land kv key fix behind flag + e2e test (ETA tomorrow)
- olivia: prepare canary plan for bucketed batching (ETA tomorrow)
maria: tagging @oncall for immediate mitigation if p99 > 1s again :oncall: 
ashwin: Quick note — we should also add a runtime metric: kernel-flap-rate and kv-miss-rate per-request-id so SRE can alert sooner.
maria: Thanks all. Re-running canary tonight. I'll post updates here.
